items.summary: Astrophysicist Brice Ménard used Anthropic's Claude Science and AI agents to create the first complete ultraviolet map of the sky, by processing and calibrating data from multiple space missions.

items.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
items.summary: Sophos has significantly reduced cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automated 52% of MDR cases by utilizing OpenAI's Daybreak AI.

items.title: Eight Years, Two Tech Booms, One Factory Problem: Inside Black Lake’s Bet on Industrial AI
items.summary: The article explores how Chinese startup Black Lake is applying artificial intelligence solutions in industrial settings to address factory problems.

items.title: An Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Large-Scale Semantic Table Interpretation and Data Quality Assessment
items.summary: This research proposes an explainable, header-centric framework for large-scale semantic table interpretation and data quality assessment, focusing on tabular metadata for Knowledge Graph quality.

items.title: Learning How to Search for Plans with Exponentially Less Space
items.summary: Presents a method for learning search control as an indexical policy to reduce space complexity in heuristic search for AI planning.

items.title: When Interfaces Speak: Data-Aware Generative UI Harness for Active Interaction
items.summary: Proposes GenUI-Harness, a data-aware generative UI system designed to improve human-agent interaction by providing structured information and guided user experiences.

items.title: Balancing Reference Guidance and Free Generation in Trajectory Rollouts for Reasoning RL
items.summary: Studies the optimal balance between reference guidance and free generation in trajectory rollouts for training reasoning reinforcement learning models.

items.title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasing
items.summary: Presents a research finding that output alignment is crucial for improving the performance of long-term time series forecasting models.

items.title: When Lower Reconstruction Loss Hurts: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
items.summary: Investigates how minimizing reconstruction loss in low-bit LLM quantization does not always improve model performance, proposing a distributionally robust refinement method.

items.title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
items.summary: Introduces Harness Compilation, an offline procedure that optimizes the division of labor between a small vision-language model and its external harness to improve performance.

items.title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
items.summary: Discusses a method using possibilistic reasoning for autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs, focusing on generating and testing hypotheses adaptively.

items.title: DivMoE: Fine-Grained MoE Upcycling via Cross-Domain Expert Composition
items.summary: Introduces DivMoE, a method for fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts upcycling through cross-domain expert composition, aimed at efficiently scaling large language models.

items.title: Finsler Flow Matching: Dynamics-Aware Geodesic Interpolation for Single-Snapshot Trajectory Inference
items.summary: This paper introduces Finsler Flow Matching, a generative approach that uses dynamics-aware geodesic interpolation to infer single-cell trajectories from snapshot data, leveraging Markov transition kernels to model cellular transitions.

items.title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
items.summary: EvoSim explores how AI can be used to learn and construct physics-based models, connecting scientific explanation with quantitative prediction by selecting processes, defining equations, and identifying parameters.

items.title: RL-ARC: Calibrating Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-guided Uncertainty
items.summary: RL-ARC is a method designed to calibrate large reasoning models, which are often overconfident due to Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), by incorporating reasoning-guided uncertainty.

items.title: UniData: Universal Multimodal Instruction Generation Pipeline
items.summary: UniData introduces a universal multimodal instruction generation pipeline designed to create high-quality, diverse instruction datasets for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), addressing the challenge of costly manual data curation.

items.title: Equal Path Cost, Unequal Output Effects: Understanding Perturbation Propagation in Diffusion Models
items.summary: This research investigates how perturbations propagate within diffusion models during their sampling procedures, revealing that equal path costs can lead to unequal output effects and contributing to understanding generative control and efficiency.

items.title: Estimating great expectations under autoregressive language models with potentials
items.summary: This paper introduces a more efficient method for estimating the expectations of test functionals under autoregressive language models, addressing the computational expense typically associated with such estimations by exploiting next-token conditioning.

items.title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
items.summary: This research aims to advance affective computing by tracing cognition-oriented emotion from causes to consequences in real-world social scenes, moving beyond categorical recognition to understand emotion as an unfolding process using large multimodal models.

items.title: SpikeSSL: A Universal Spike Inference Framework with Dynamics-Informed State-Space Layers
items.summary: SpikeSSL introduces a universal spike inference framework that uses dynamics-informed state-space layers to accurately infer neural spikes from two-photon calcium imaging data, addressing generalization challenges across diverse calcium indicators.

items.title: From Chain-of-Thought to Loops: Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers
items.summary: This paper introduces Non-Autoregressive Latent Reasoning via Looped Transformers as an alternative to Chain-of-Thought, providing language models with additional computation for improved performance without explicit autoregressive token generation.

items.title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
items.summary: This paper introduces Fed-GRPO, a federated optimization method for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning, specifically addressing the challenge of decentralized data access in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

items.title: AtomWorld-Mirror: Macro-Step World Modeling of Critical Evolution Backbones for Materials Dynamics
items.summary: This paper introduces AtomWorld-Mirror, a macro-step world modeling approach for simulating materials dynamics to study long-term evolution processes like diffusion and defect dynamics. It addresses the computational cost of conventional atomistic simulators by focusing on critical evolution backbones.

items.title: ReTeach: Building a Self-Teacher through Multi-Round Reflection and Retry
items.summary: This paper presents ReTeach, a method for building a "self-teacher" to improve AI reasoning through multi-round reflection and retry during self-distillation. It explores how a self-teacher can gain an advantage over a student model without external guidance.

items.title: Freeze the Decoder, Heal the Encoder: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for SVD-Based KV-Cache Compression
items.summary: This paper explores parameter-efficient adaptation techniques for SVD-based KV-Cache compression, arguing that comparing fine-tuning recipes with a shared learning rate can be flawed due to differing trainable parameter counts.

items.title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
items.summary: This paper introduces SPERA, a spherical prior EEG foundation model designed for non-invasive neural activity measurement. It uses geometry- and frequency-aware latent prediction to address challenges in building general-purpose EEG models due to data heterogeneity.

items.title: Coverage, Not Difficulty, Sets How Much Synthetic Data an Activation Probe Needs
items.summary: This paper investigates the amount of synthetic data required for training activation probes that monitor deployed language models. It concludes that coverage, rather than difficulty, is the determining factor for the probe's effectiveness across various monitoring concepts.

items.title: Temporal transformer CAN encoder with federated lightweight heads for anomaly detection
items.summary: This paper proposes a temporal transformer CAN encoder with federated lightweight heads for anomaly detection in modern vehicle Controller Area Network (CAN) bus communication. It aims to identify unusual timing, payload, or message patterns that indicate anomalies.

items.title: Recurrent Self-Improvement: Dynamic Cross-Loop On-Policy Distillation for Looped Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces a recurrent self-improvement method for Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) through dynamic cross-loop on-policy distillation. It aims to address challenges in effectively post-training LoopLMs to improve reasoning capabilities.

items.title: Sample-Efficiency of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
items.summary: This paper analyzes the sample-efficiency of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, a recently proposed AI architecture, in the context of deep reinforcement learning. It investigates their ability to learn physical relationships with fewer samples compared to classical control approaches.

items.title: Visible Reasoning Is Not a Universal Optimizer: Persona- and Thinking-Dependent Effects in Analytics Code Generation
items.summary: This paper challenges the notion of Visible Chain-of-Thought (CoT) as a universal optimizer, demonstrating persona- and thinking-dependent effects in analytics code generation. It highlights how factors like natural-language ambiguity and target-language constraints influence CoT effectiveness.

items.title: Coverage-Aware Reasoning with Medical Tokens for Diagnosis Prediction
items.summary: This paper explores the potential of large language models (LLMs) for next-visit diagnosis prediction by integrating longitudinal clinical evidence. It proposes a coverage-aware reasoning approach using medical tokens to improve diagnosis prediction.

items.title: Leakage-Controlled Multimodal Learning for Diagnosis and Progression Prediction in Alzheimer's Disease Research
items.summary: This study presents a leakage-controlled multimodal multitask framework for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis and progression prediction. It combines an adapted SFCN MRI encoder, causal clinical Transformers, and ODE-GRU dynamics to handle irregular visits and incomplete modalities.

items.title: PXtal: Learning to Align Powder X-Ray Diffraction and Crystal Structures under Information Asymmetry across Modalities
items.summary: This paper introduces PXtal, a method for learning to align Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) patterns and crystal structures despite information asymmetry between these modalities. It addresses the challenge of compressing 3D structures into 1D patterns in scientific multimodal learning.

items.title: Beyond Owls: Subliminal Learning Can Transfer Learned Capabilities and Backdoors
items.summary: This research introduces subliminal learning, a technique where a teacher model distills traits to a student model using semantically unrelated data, demonstrating transfer of capabilities and backdoors.

items.title: Teaching PPG How not Who: Fixed-Effects Distillation from ECG
items.summary: This paper examines ECG-to-PPG distillation, finding that it primarily teaches a model 'who' the person is rather than 'how' their cardiovascular state changes, which is crucial for wearables.

items.title: Explaining the Saliency Map Sparsity of Adversarially-Trained Neural Networks
items.summary: This research investigates the sparsity patterns observed in saliency maps of adversarially-trained neural networks, aiming to understand why deep neural networks make specific predictions.

items.title: Learning infinite context windows in recurrent architectures via spatial neural computing
items.summary: This paper presents a new method for recurrent neural networks to capture long-range dependencies by learning 'infinite context windows' through spatial neural computing, addressing vanishing gradients.

items.title: NEMORA: Neural Equivariant Multipole Operators for Long-Range Atomistic Learning
items.summary: This research introduces NEMORA (Neural Equivariant Multipole Operators), a new architecture for equivariant graph neural networks that accurately describes long-range interatomic interactions for machine-learned potentials.

items.title: Symbolic Density Estimators for Unnormalized Distributions
items.summary: This research addresses the fundamental challenge of estimating the symbolic or analytical form of probability density functions from observed samples for unnormalized distributions.

items.title: MotherTree: Meta-learning on synthetic data improves decision tree training
items.summary: This paper introduces MotherTree, a meta-learning approach that uses synthetic data to improve the training of traditional decision tree algorithms, contrasting with tabular foundation models.

items.title: Similar Predictive Fit but Different Latent Dynamics: Characterizing Learned Dynamical Structure in Personalized Models of Brain Disorders
items.summary: This research investigates personalized AI models for brain disorders, showing that their learned latent dynamics can reveal clinically relevant differences even when predictive accuracy is similar.

items.title: KDFP: A first-principles approach to knowledge distillation in large language models
items.summary: This paper proposes KDFP, a first-principles approach to knowledge distillation for large language models, aiming to improve smaller student models using representations from larger teacher models.

items.title: Barron Optimal Transport I: Generative Modeling
items.summary: This paper introduces the Barron Optimal Transport framework for generative modeling, where the transport cost quantifies neural network complexity for mapping reference distributions to target samples.

items.title: Gen-PINNs: Generative Adversarial Physics Informed Neural Networks for solving partial differential equations
items.summary: This paper presents Gen-PINNs, a new method combining Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Generative Adversarial Networks to solve Partial Differential Equations by leveraging adversarial learning.

items.title: Language Models for Page-Level Layout Decisions in E-commerce Search
items.summary: This research explores the application of language models to make page-level layout decisions in e-commerce search, integrating recommender system modules for a more effective user experience.

items.title: Adaptive Multi-Discriminator WGAN Framework for Resource-Constrained Internet of Vehicles Using Reinforcement Learning and Game Theory
items.summary: This paper proposes an adaptive multi-discriminator WGAN framework, enhanced with reinforcement learning and game theory, for managing machine learning workloads in resource-constrained Internet of Vehicles environments.

items.title: World-Model Policy Arbiter for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces a World-Model Policy Arbiter for goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, designed to intelligently select the best policy from a diverse set to improve task performance across various scenarios.

items.title: Rethinking the Tradeoff Between Temporal Encoding and Nonlinear Computation in Spiking Language Models
items.summary: This research re-examines the tradeoff between temporal encoding and nonlinear attention computation in spiking language models, introducing Spora as a new design for joint optimization.

items.title: Spectrally Targeted Muon
items.summary: This paper presents the Muon optimizer, an algorithm that orthogonalizes update matrices and sets singular values to one, proving effective for training large language models by potentially amplifying small singular directions.

items.title: ASPIRE: Saddle-Point Discovery through Set Prediction and Physical Refinement
items.summary: The ASPIRE method is introduced for saddle-point discovery through set prediction and physical refinement, aiming to overcome computational bottlenecks in identifying atomic rearrangement mechanisms and activation barriers for event-driven models.

items.title: Budgeted Multi-Source Counterfactual Annotation for Off-Policy Evaluation
items.summary: This work explores budgeted multi-source counterfactual annotation for off-policy evaluation, aiming to mitigate high-variance reweighting or reward-model extrapolation caused by limited behavior-policy coverage in logged data.

items.title: Optimizing Large Language Models with Chained LMOs
items.summary: This research introduces chained linear minimization oracles (chained LMOs) to provide a unified perspective for optimizing large language models, building on the success of optimizers like Muon that use matrix normalizations.

items.title: Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models
items.summary: This paper discusses multi-bandwidth distribution matching distillation, exploring its equivalence with drifting models to enhance one-step generative model effectiveness, and revealing connections between Diffusion and Flow Style Generative Models.

items.title: Invariant-Measure Reasoners: Stable Representations for Latent Reasoning
items.summary: This research introduces Invariant-Measure Reasoners, which provide stable representations for latent reasoning models where the sequence of latent states may converge to a compact subset rather than a fixed point with increasing recurrent depth.

items.title: Low-rank tensor structure of precipitation and its application to satellite-reference merging
items.summary: This work applies low-rank tensor structures to represent and estimate daily precipitation over the contiguous United States, suggesting a method for satellite-reference merging despite precipitation's intermittent nature.

items.title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
items.summary: This study investigates emergent inverse-depth scaling from nonlinearity in attention mechanisms to better understand the underlying mechanisms of scaling laws and their impact on model performance with parameter count.

items.title: Measuring and Mitigating Solution Mode Collapse in RLVR
items.summary: This paper addresses the problem of solution mode collapse in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for language models, aiming to measure and mitigate instances where models produce redundant correct answers.

items.title: Stability-Plasticity Balance via Singular-Vector Selection in LLM Continual Learning
items.summary: This research proposes a method for achieving stability-plasticity balance in LLM continual learning through singular-vector selection, aiming to prevent catastrophic forgetting while adapting models to new domains.

items.title: DaCe-DT: Data-Centric Offline Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning via Adaptive Prompts and Trajectory Correction for Heterogeneous Tasks
items.summary: DaCe-DT is introduced as a data-centric approach to offline multi-task reinforcement learning, utilizing adaptive prompts and trajectory correction to improve learning ability and generalization performance for heterogeneous tasks.

items.title: Cova-PINN: Cross-Domain Conservation Physics-Informed Neural Network for Fluid-Solid Conjugate Heat Transfer in Complex Geometries
items.summary: This paper presents Cova-PINN, a cross-domain conservation physics-informed neural network designed to solve fluid-solid conjugate heat transfer in complex geometries by effectively enforcing governing equations and interface conditions.

items.title: Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models
items.summary: Diffu-LoRA is proposed as a novel low-rank adaptation method for personalizing text-to-image diffusion models, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning while preserving subject identity.

items.title: Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System
items.summary: This paper proposes a large language model-assisted approach for preparing Transportation Management Plans, demonstrating its application in a case study with the WisDOT WisTMP System to streamline a labor-intensive process.

items.title: Cognitive Thermometers: Machine Learning and Logical Complexity
items.summary: This research investigates how machine learning and logical complexity can illuminate the human mind's representation of semantic categories and the preference for certain meanings in natural languages.

items.title: Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders
items.summary: This work introduces Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders, an autoencoder architecture that uses residual downscaling and upscaling to learn a compressed latent representation of text.

items.title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
items.summary: This paper proposes a 'Clarify, Then Focus' principle for statement normalization in enterprise conversation analytics, aiming to improve efficiency by standardizing and prioritizing information from millions of interactions.

items.title: Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values
items.summary: This paper investigates sparse attention in Large Language Models (LLMs), proposing it as a matrix approximation technique rather than a value selection process to improve efficiency by reducing the quadratic cost of attention.

items.title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: This paper introduces Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation (OPD), a method to efficiently transfer capabilities from a teacher to a student language model for complex multi-turn agentic tasks.

items.title: Large Language Models for Machine Translation Quality Annotation: Humans and Models Are Both Challenged
items.summary: This paper evaluates the effectiveness of Large Language Models (LLMs) as an alternative to human judgment for Machine Translation (MT) quality annotation, highlighting challenges for both humans and models.

items.title: AI4Fire: Evaluating Large Language Models on Wildfire Tasks
items.summary: This paper evaluates the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on wildfire management tasks, assessing their capability with and without grounding to understand their practical application and potential risks.

items.title: Back in Style: A Sociolinguistic Approach to Authoring and Measuring Persona Fidelity in User Simulation
items.summary: This paper explores a sociolinguistic approach to authoring and measuring persona fidelity in user simulators, aiming to improve the realism of simulated users for evaluating agentic systems.

items.title: Prompts versus Rules: Auditing and Controlling Speech Naturalness Behaviors in Voice User Simulators
items.summary: This paper compares prompts versus rules for auditing and controlling speech naturalness behaviors like disfluency and interruption in voice user simulators used to evaluate voice agents.

items.title: FedAlphaEdit: Null-Space-Aligned Merging for Collaborative Knowledge Editing
items.summary: This paper introduces FedAlphaEdit, a null-space-aligned merging method for collaborative knowledge editing that allows multiple institutions to integrate private edits into a single LLM without sharing raw requests.

items.title: Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated
items.summary: This paper argues that clinicians' use of Large Language Models (LLMs) diverges from how these models are typically evaluated, suggesting that current benchmarks may not accurately reflect real-world performance in healthcare.

items.title: Lapras: Latent Reasoning for Time Series Language Models
items.summary: This paper presents Lapras, a method for Latent Reasoning in Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) that enables them to reason over temporal signals and generate natural language answers and explanations.

items.title: SFT-as-Context Mitigates Forgetting in Supervised Fine-Tuning
items.summary: This paper proposes 'SFT-as-Context' as a method to mitigate forgetting general capabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs) during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for specialized tasks.

items.title: Can a System-One LLM Perform Knowledge Tracing When Few or No Learners Are Logged?
items.summary: This paper investigates whether a System-One Large Language Model (LLM) can perform knowledge tracing effectively when very few or no learner logs are available, addressing a common cold-start problem.

items.title: The "10th Juror": Open-Set Standpoint Screening for Bureaucratic Bias Detection
items.summary: This paper introduces 'The 10th Juror,' a system for open-set standpoint screening to detect bureaucratic bias in Dutch government documents, aiming to identify, ground, rewrite, and verify problematic language.

items.title: Local Prototype Reconstruction for Text-Compatible Speech-to-LLM Bridge Pretraining
items.summary: This paper proposes Local Prototype Reconstruction for text-compatible speech-to-LLM bridge pretraining, aiming to improve the interface geometry and pretraining objective between speech encoders and LLMs.

items.title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
items.summary: This paper introduces LadderEdit, a method for edit-level residual compression of LoRA adapters to achieve memory-efficient lifelong editing in Large Language Models (LLMs).

items.title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces RAG-Stress, a controlled framework to probe the limits of evidence reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models, particularly when presented with misleading evidence.

items.title: Phonological Interference in Multilingual Speech Models
items.summary: This paper examines phonological interference in multilingual speech models, specifically how they perform when exposed to input that combines sounds from multiple languages rather than a single training language.

items.title: When Do We Need On-Policy Distillation? Distilling on Offline Student Rollouts Is Often Better
items.summary: This paper investigates the conditions under which on-policy distillation (OPD) is necessary for transferring capabilities from teacher to student models, suggesting that distilling on offline student rollouts is often more effective.

items.title: BeliefScope: Diagnosing Evidence-Driven Revision and Pressure-Induced Shifts in Large Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces BeliefScope, a controlled method to diagnose whether Large Language Models revise propositions based on relevant evidence or directional user pressure. It aims to distinguish the sources driving an LLM's response changes.

items.title: ReCal: Calibrating Structured Pruning for On-Policy Distillation Recovery
items.summary: This research introduces ReCal, a method to calibrate structured pruning for reasoning language models to mitigate capability degradation and improve on-policy distillation (OPD) recovery. It addresses how pruning damage can limit subsequent recovery during offline distillation.

items.title: Fact over Fiction: Detection of Pathological Hallucinations in Sinhala-to-English Neural Machine Translation
items.summary: This research focuses on detecting pathological hallucinations in Sinhala-to-English Neural Machine Translation, particularly in low-resource settings. It addresses the vulnerability of NMT models to produce fluent but semantically unrelated translations.

items.title: Adversarial Cues in Decision Models Used as Judges: The Role of Request Presentation
items.summary: This research investigates how adversarial cues and the presentation of structured judging requests influence decision models when used as judges. It demonstrates that subtle changes in candidate presentation can affect a model's ability to reject explicitly wrong values.

items.title: Does Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) Dominate Arabic Dialects in LLMs? A Representation-Level Analysis
items.summary: This paper investigates whether Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) dominates Arabic dialects in Large Language Models at a representation level. It tests the hypothesis that LLMs' internal representations are primarily influenced by MSA, even when processing dialectal Arabic.

items.title: Residual Advantage: Student-Relative Teacher Guidance for RL with Verifiable Rewards
items.summary: This research introduces "Residual Advantage," a student-relative teacher guidance method for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD). It aims to provide token-level guidance for post-training reasoning models, addressing limitations of single-outcome labels.

items.title: When Can You Prune Your Network? A Study of Intermediate Neurons in Multilingual Speech Parsing
items.summary: This study investigates when and how to prune neural networks, specifically examining the effectiveness of intermediate neurons in existing architectures for end-to-end multilingual speech parsing. It aims to understand the impact of pruning on this task.

items.title: Learning the Loop, Not Just the Page: Execution-Grounded Loop Learning for Web Generation
items.summary: This research proposes "Execution-Grounded Loop Learning" for functional web generation, focusing on diagnosing and repairing imperfect implementations rather than solely optimizing the final page quality. It addresses the challenge of understanding and fixing generator process errors.

items.title: Smoothing the Top-k Exposure Boundary for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
items.summary: This research proposes a method for smoothing the top-k exposure boundary in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models. This technique aims to refine the expert routing mechanism, which traditionally enforces a static choice of experts and converts continuous routing into a rigid step function.

items.title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
items.summary: This research explores adapting English quality classifiers for selecting high-quality pretraining data for multilingual large language models, particularly for low-resource languages. The goal is to improve LLM performance through better data selection.

items.title: Probing for Long-Horizon Deductive Reasoning Capabilities in Language Models with Prolog
items.summary: This research investigates the long-horizon deductive reasoning capabilities of large language models when processing extensive contexts. It uses Prolog to probe how LLMs perform deeper logical reasoning beyond simple retrieval.

items.title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
items.summary: This paper analyzes how the rapid turnover of large language model versions undermines the reliability of screening methods for AI-assisted scientific writing. It quantifies the challenge of maintaining effective detection benchmarks when LLMs are constantly changing.

items.title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
items.summary: This research investigates whether phonologically informed tokenization can improve end-to-end speech recognition for German, a morphologically rich language. It compares different tokenizer families in a cross-domain study.

items.title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
items.summary: This research investigates "thinking inertia" in large language models, exploring how LLMs behave when explicitly instructed not to think. It proposes methods to measure this "no-thinking" behavior.

items.title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
items.summary: This research proposes SLVR, a method to improve visual reasoning in multimodal large language models by encouraging structured latent visual reasoning via human-like reasoning flows. It aims to make MLLMs rely less on linguistic priors and more on task-relevant visual evidence.

items.title: A Camera-Native Stereo VR180 Dataset
items.summary: This paper introduces the first camera-native stereo VR180 dataset, collected using professional fisheye cameras with lens calibration. It provides a clean resource for immersive VR180 video research, unlike existing resources from online platforms.

items.title: VICO: Visual Environments Co-Evolving for Vision-Language Model Reasoning
items.summary: This research introduces VICO, a method for training vision-language models where visual environments co-evolve with the model's capabilities. It addresses the limitation of static training environments in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

items.title: Enabling Preference-driven Unlearning in Few-step Distilled Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
items.summary: This research presents a method for enabling preference-driven unlearning in few-step distilled text-to-image diffusion models. The goal is to suppress the generation of harmful or undesired content, enhancing model safety.

items.title: SPLIT-RL: Staged Perception-Language Reasoning Training with Claim-Level Advantages
items.summary: This paper introduces SPLIT-RL, a staged perception-language reasoning training method for vision-language models, using claim-level advantages. It aims to improve both visual and language reasoning by training them through a unified chain-of-thought.

items.title: Less from More: Reinforcing Sparse Video Reasoning from Dense References
items.summary: This research challenges the assumption that more temporal observations always lead to better reasoning in video-language models. It proposes a method, SAVE, to enable reliable sparse video reasoning even with limited temporal evidence.

items.title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
items.summary: This research proposes Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation to improve fine-grained image retrieval by enhancing the global semantic descriptor. It addresses the limitation of single [CLS] tokens in vision transformers for complex retrieval tasks.

items.title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
items.summary: This research explores the feasibility of using raw web video, without captions or text loss, as mid-training data for pretrained language models. It investigates whether this approach can further improve multimodal large language models.

items.title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
items.summary: This paper describes a method for active robot vision that enables a robot to control its camera to reveal task-relevant information for viewpoint-dependent question answering without rendering.

items.title: Learning What to Trust in Multimodal Learning under Noisy Supervision
items.summary: This paper explores methods for multimodal classification to learn what to trust under noisy supervision, aiming to achieve more accurate predictions without relying on high-quality ground-truth labels.

items.title: Contrast Enhancement or Noise Reduction? On Improving Cervical Cancer Classification
items.summary: This research investigates the impact of image preprocessing algorithms, specifically contrast enhancement or noise reduction, on the performance of deep learning models for cervical cancer classification.

items.title: IntrinSync: Joint Intrinsic Decomposition and Reciprocal Rendering
items.summary: This paper introduces IntrinSync, a method for joint intrinsic decomposition and reciprocal rendering that aims to produce reliable and mutually compatible intrinsic maps from images.

items.title: Improving Image-Based Nutrition Estimation Through Multimodal Food-Item Verification and Recovery
items.summary: This research proposes a framework using multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to improve image-based nutrition estimation by verifying and recovering food items for more accurate portion estimation.

items.title: A Unified Score Matching Paradigm for Video Anomaly Detection and Anticipation
items.summary: This paper proposes a unified score matching paradigm for video anomaly detection and anticipation, addressing limitations of existing generative approaches in computer vision tasks.

items.title: AutoAdapt: Reliable Few-Shot Adaptation under Clinical Distribution Shifts
items.summary: This paper addresses reliable few-shot adaptation for large pretrained clinical models, proposing a method to adapt these models to new hospitals with small labeled patient cohorts under distribution shifts.

items.title: Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Registration: A Comprehensive Review, Challenges and Prospects
items.summary: A comprehensive review of multimodal remote sensing image registration, outlining its challenges and prospects, which is crucial for collaborative processing and downstream applications of remote sensing data.

items.title: Dissecting Representation Structure in Vision Transformers: A Rigorous Architectural Study
items.summary: A rigorous architectural study dissecting the representation structure in Vision Transformers, investigating how module-level features and their interactions contribute to performance estimation and generalization behavior.

items.title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
items.summary: Introduces MiniVer-V, a method designed for short-video fact-checking that identifies the minimal sufficient evidence required to support a verification conclusion, addressing the challenge of noise or topical relevance in existing approaches.

items.title: Attributing HOW, Not Just WHICH: Counterfactual Response Trajectories for Diffusion Models
items.summary: Focuses on counterfactual response trajectories for diffusion models to attribute how outputs are generated, rather than just which training examples contributed, allowing for better understanding of internal changes.

items.title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
items.summary: Presents V-CoLA, a method for vision token compression using linear attention to reduce the substantial computational overhead of vision-language models, especially with large input sequences.

items.title: Efficient Multi-Granularity Knowledge Transfer for Radiology Report Generation
items.summary: Focuses on efficient multi-granularity knowledge transfer to automatically generate radiology reports from X-ray images, significantly improving the efficiency of radiologists by accurately identifying and describing diseases.

items.title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
items.summary: Present Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends learned trajectory priors for efficient parallel generation and structural repair, by using geometry-guided token search.

items.title: Higher-Order Action Supervision Makes A Strong Policy Class
items.summary: This research investigates how higher-order action supervision can enhance data-driven decision-making methods like imitation learning and reinforcement learning, aiming to improve control stability and robustness for real-world applications.

items.summary: This paper presents three pieces of evidence suggesting that the autoreconstructor in a natural language autoencoder (NLA) does not genuinely understand semantics or syntax. It contributes to fundamental research on the linguistic capabilities of AI systems.

items.title: Hesai Launches Kosmo, a 3D World Data Engine With an 8K AI Spatial Camera
items.summary: Lidar maker Hesai launched Kosmo, a 3D World Data Engine featuring an 8K AI spatial camera. This system converts real spaces into 3D assets, primarily for robot training and world models for physical AI.

items.title: Hong Kong vies for role in robot boom with embodied AI hub launch - South China Morning Post
items.summary: Hong Kong is establishing an embodied AI hub to strengthen its position in the burgeoning robotics sector. This initiative aims to capitalize on the robot boom and foster advancements in embodied artificial intelligence.

items.title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
items.summary: This research presents TGrasp6D, a system that uses task-informed vision-language priors and pose refinement to achieve zero-shot, task-oriented 6DoF grasping for purposeful robotic manipulation.

items.title: EgoJEPA: Beyond Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
items.summary: This work introduces EgoJEPA, a method to transfer dexterous manipulation skills from egocentric human videos to robots, moving beyond simple pose retargeting for more effective robot control.

items.title: Planning to Learn: Real-Time Robust Adaptive Control on the GPU with Guaranteed Future Learning
items.summary: This paper investigates real-time robust adaptive control for robots on GPUs, focusing on methods that ensure robot safety and reduce uncertainty by incorporating guaranteed future parameter learning during planning.

items.title: LEAP: Gradient Flow Augmented Lagrangian Trajectory Optimization for Contact Constrained Robots
items.summary: This research introduces LEAP, a gradient flow augmented Lagrangian trajectory optimization method for generating dynamically feasible, contact-constrained motions for legged and manipulating robots.

items.title: SOMA: Stack-of-Objects Manipulation using a Quadruped Robot
items.summary: This paper introduces SOMA, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that enables quadrupedal robots to perform whole-body non-prehensile manipulation for stacking objects in unpredictable environments.

items.title: MoCaP: Mobile Code-as-Policies for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation from Passive Human Videos
items.summary: This work explores MoCaP, a system using mobile code-as-policies for zero-shot mobile manipulation, allowing robots to learn and adapt skills from passive human videos of everyday activities.

items.title: Manifold Generative Annealing for Contact Constraint-aware Impedance Control with Reinforcement Learning Prior
items.summary: This research proposes Manifold Generative Annealing for Contact Constraint-aware Impedance Control, combining reinforcement learning priors to enable robust coordinated motion in contact-rich robotic tasks.

items.title: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
items.summary: This paper introduces KODA, a method for kinematics-observation data alignment to facilitate humanoid robot learning from scalable human egocentric demonstrations.

items.title: CLIS-MPPI: Closed-Loop Model Predictive Path Integral Control With Initial-State Sampling Under Execution Delay
items.summary: CLIS-MPPI presents a closed-loop Model Predictive Path Integral control method with initial-state sampling to address execution delays in robotics motion planning, suitable for nonlinear dynamics.

items.title: MR-MPCC: Model Predictive Contouring Control for Robotic Manipulator Tracking under Moving Reference Frames
items.summary: MR-MPCC develops a Model Predictive Contouring Control for robotic manipulators to maintain small path-tracking errors under moving reference frames, crucial for tasks like machining and surgical automation.

items.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
items.summary: CarryOn presents a dual-loop harness designed to provide personalized and reliable assistance from robots, addressing current limitations of generalist VLA models in real-world robotic applications.

items.title: TRACE: Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion
items.summary: TRACE introduces Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion, allowing users to generate and refine robot movements using natural language commands.

items.title: Attribution-Gated Joint Estimation of Intention and Capability for Assist-as-Needed Upper-Limb Robots
items.summary: A dual-measurand multimodal MHE-MPC architecture is developed for Assist-as-Needed (AAN) control in upper-limb robots, distinguishing between intended motion and changes in torque capability.

items.title: A Flow-Theoretic Multimodal Control Framework Fusing Mental and Physical Engagement for Upper-Limb Rehabilitation
items.summary: This research proposes a flow-theoretic multimodal control framework that fuses mental and physical engagement for upper-limb rehabilitation, improving robot-assisted training by distinguishing user states.

items.title: SPEAR: Selective Preference Elicitation with Adaptive Rewards for VLM-Guided Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This paper introduces SPEAR, a framework designed to improve VLM-guided robotic manipulation by addressing inference costs and VLM abstention in visually challenging comparisons. It focuses on selective preference elicitation with adaptive rewards to make robotic manipulation more practical.

items.title: MAIA: Anticipating Interaction Anomalies in Contact-Rich Manipulation via Multimodal World Models
items.summary: This paper introduces MAIA, a system that anticipates interaction anomalies in contact-rich manipulation tasks by using multimodal world models. It aims to detect execution deviations early, enabling timely corrective actions for reliable robotic operation.

items.title: Uni-PNP: Unified Prehensile and Non-prehensile Policy Learning for Generalizable Object Pose Reaching
items.summary: This research presents Uni-PNP, a unified policy learning framework for generalizable object pose reaching that combines both prehensile and non-prehensile actions. It aims to improve the coordination of contact motion during complex robotic object manipulation tasks.

items.title: Trajectory-based Diffusion from One-shot Human Video for Generalizable Manipulation
items.summary: This research explores using trajectory-based diffusion models derived from one-shot human video to enable generalizable manipulation in robots via imitation learning. The goal is to make data collection for robotic tasks more scalable by leveraging natural human demonstrations.

items.title: Sub-Millisecond Reflexes for Continuous Physical Human-Robot Interaction
items.summary: This research presents an open-source solution to enable sub-millisecond reflexes for continuous physical human-robot interaction, aiming to overcome delays in existing ROS 2 control architectures. The goal is to allow robots to rapidly adapt their control behavior without interrupting task execution.

items.title: What Should Robot Policies Learn to Predict? Rethinking Supervision Targets in Vision-Language-Action Learning
items.summary: This research paper rethinks supervision targets in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) learning for robots, questioning whether action prediction should be the sole primary signal. It investigates the role of auxiliary objectives like latent-action and future-vision prediction in improving robot policy learning.

items.title: Leju Robotics Puts 15 Humanoids on an Auto Parts Loading Line, Reporting About 98% Success
items.summary: Leju Robotics has deployed 15 humanoid robots to load auto parts at a Hangzhou plant, achieving about 98% success rate in routine shifts.

items.title: Humanoid robot kicks drone across the room at robotics conference - Yahoo News UK
items.summary: A humanoid robot demonstrated its capabilities by kicking a drone across a room at a robotics conference.

items.title: Ubtech Robotics Pursues Three Distinct Growth Paths, Each at a Different Stage of Maturity - ad-hoc-news.de
items.summary: Ubtech Robotics is pursuing three distinct growth paths, each at a different stage of maturity.

items.title: Agility chooses Nyobolt for ultra-fast charging for Digit 5 humanoid
items.summary: Agility Robotics has selected Nyobolt to provide ultra-fast charging technology for its Digit 5 humanoid robot, enabling it to operate for up to 20 hours daily.

items.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
items.summary: VLX-Go proposes a method for robust embodied visual tracking for robots, utilizing multi-stage learning and on-policy refinement. The system enables a robot to identify and follow a designated target through an environment.

items.title: $\lambda_0$: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: This research presents $\lambda_0$, a method focused on scaling open-world egocentric human data to facilitate the training of humanoid robots for loco-manipulation tasks. It aims to provide a scalable alternative to costly robot demonstrations for complex whole-body interactions.

items.title: Contact-UAN: Unsupervised Actuator Networks as a Residual World Model for Humanoid Control
items.summary: Contact-UAN introduces unsupervised actuator networks as a residual world model to improve the transfer of humanoid policies from simulation to hardware. This approach aims to address sim-to-real gaps in force interactions, enhancing torque efficiency and robustness to impacts.

items.title: Tread: A Visuo-Inertial Framework for Terrain and Locomotion Context-Aware Gait-Phase and Speed Estimation in Wearable Robotics
items.summary: Tread introduces a visuo-inertial framework for wearable assistive robots to continuously estimate terrain, locomotion mode, gait phase, and walking speed. This unified system aims to provide context-aware perception for enhanced robot control.

items.title: Receding-Horizon Next-Best-View Planning for Highly Occluded Target Perception
items.summary: This paper presents a receding-horizon next-best-view planning method for robotic systems to efficiently perceive highly occluded targets. The technique enables robots to actively select optimal viewpoints to progressively acquire information about a target.

items.title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
items.summary: DexMimic introduces a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy for robotics, learned from human hand-object interaction datasets via value-guided reset allocation. This approach aims to overcome the limitations of specialist policies for individual manipulation trajectories.

items.title: Collective Learning for Unified Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Dynamics Adaptation
items.summary: This paper explores collective learning for unified robotic manipulation, which involves aggregating multi-robot experience to adapt to embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. The goal is to develop a collective policy for state-based Cartesian manipulation across diverse robotic forms.

items.title: FACT: A Multimodal Force-Action-Track Foundation Model for Human-to-Robot Dexterity
items.summary: FACT is a multimodal force-action-track foundation model designed to transfer dexterous manipulation skills from human demonstrations to robots. It integrates visual, proprioceptive, and force measurements to enable robots to anticipate and regulate interaction forces.

items.title: A Mode-Unified, Continuous, and Biomimetic Control Strategy of a Robotic Lower Limb Prosthesis
items.summary: This paper presents a mode-unified, continuous, and biomimetic control strategy for a robotic lower limb prosthesis. The framework represents knee and ankle biomechanics continuously, overcoming limitations of discrete locomotion mode designs for various terrains.

items.title: PACER: Process-Aware VLA Policy Learning from Human Corrections for Robotic Disassembly
items.summary: PACER introduces Process-Aware VLA Policy Learning from human corrections for robotic disassembly of end-of-life products. This method aims to enable robots to adapt to product variations and perform contact-rich manipulation by following prerequisite sequences.

items.title: MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots
items.summary: MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies) is a framework for robots to manage instruction-conditioned incremental grounding. It enables robots to efficiently maintain target-room decisions from persistent language instructions without re-evaluating every room as the environment changes.

items.title: Probabilistic Physics Digital Twin for Human-Robot Interaction
items.summary: This research explores the development of a probabilistic physics digital twin for human-robot interaction in robotics. It aims to improve simulation, action outcome prediction, and planning by providing more accurate estimates of physical properties.

items.title: Beyond Kinematic Tracking: Preserving Expressive Characteristics in Humanoid Whole-Body Control
items.summary: This research explores methods for whole-body control in humanoid robots to preserve expressive motion characteristics beyond simple kinematic tracking.

items.title: A Master-to-Simulation Interface with Demonstration-Trajectory Guidance for Vascular Intervention
items.summary: This paper develops a vascular intervention interactive system using a master-to-simulation interface and demonstration-trajectory guidance to improve robotic manipulation stability and reduce radiation exposure.

items.title: A VR Training System for Robot-Assisted Vascular Intervention with Dual-Mode Control and Model-Based Interaction Response
items.summary: This paper presents a VR training system for robot-assisted vascular intervention, featuring dual-mode control and model-based interaction response for accurate robotic control and effective feedback.

items.title: From Failures to Learnable Worlds: Policy-Conditioned Environment Generation for Navigation Agents
items.summary: This research proposes a policy-conditioned environment generation method to create targeted simulated environments for training embodied navigation agents more effectively.

items.title: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
items.summary: This research introduces active generative simulation, a meta-learning approach for sim-and-real policy co-training, to optimize what data to simulate for efficient robot learning.

items.title: Dungeon and Visibility World Generator
items.summary: This paper introduces the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for constructing reproducible 2D and 3D environments to support robotic exploration and multi-agent deployment algorithms.

items.title: Back on Track: Deployment-time Policy Improvement via World Model Planning
items.summary: This research proposes improving deployment-time performance and robustness of visuomotor policies for robots through world model planning, reducing the need for extensive data collection or retraining.

items.title: RoboSpan: Learning Modular Coordination Policies for High-DoF Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation with Teleoperation
items.summary: RoboSpan focuses on learning modular coordination policies for high-DoF whole-body mobile manipulation, addressing challenges like motion heterogeneity and error accumulation in robotic systems and teleoperation.

items.title: Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System
items.summary: This research investigates the challenges of scaling vision-language-action (VLA) models from local robot manipulation to long-horizon mobile manipulation, proposing steps toward an agentic robot system.

items.title: PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
items.summary: PolyMorph presents a morphology-conditioned framework that enables reinforcement learning to develop locomotion policies for legged robots capable of cross-embodiment adaptation to varying physical forms.

items.title: Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control for Robotic Arms: Language-to-Code Decomposition and Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces Instruction-Conditioned Motion Control (ICMC), a method for language-driven robot control for robotic arms that separates parameter specification, instruction generation, and code synthesis.

items.title: F2A-ObjectNav: An Adaptive Agentic Architecture for Object-Goal Navigation
items.summary: F2A-ObjectNav proposes an adaptive agentic architecture for object-goal navigation, enabling an embodied agent to explore unfamiliar environments and reliably identify and approach target objects.

items.title: E2DRL: End-to-End Differentiable Reinforcement Learning for 3D Obstacle Avoidance in Quadruped Robots
items.summary: E2DRL explores end-to-end differentiable reinforcement learning for 3D obstacle avoidance, extending its application to legged locomotion and quadruped robots.

items.title: Eye, Robot: Learning Expressive Gaze Dynamics via a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE
items.summary: This research presents a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE model for a humanoid robot to learn expressive gaze dynamics, coordinating eye, head, and eyelid motion for more natural interaction.

items.title: Accelerating VLA Inference with Perturbation Informed Execution
items.summary: This paper proposes perturbation informed execution to accelerate inference in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which predict sequences of future robot actions by optimizing how predictions are used.

items.title: Design and Characterization of a Unified Continuum Robot Actuation Platform
items.summary: A new unified actuation platform for continuum robots is designed and characterized, enabling dexterous access in applications like minimally invasive surgery and industrial inspection.

items.summary: UBTECH and FAW-Volkswagen collaborate on using humanoid robots for factory tasks, including inspection and logistics, demonstrating real-world deployment.

items.summary: A white paper provides an overview of adaptive motion planning and tracking methods essential for humanoid robots to achieve professional athletic style movements.

items.summary: An article questions whether the enthusiasm surrounding humanoid robotics is outpacing their practical readiness for integration into real-world workplaces.

items.summary: Unitree Robotics' Wang Xingxing predicts that a tipping point for embodied intelligence in robotics could be reached within one to two years.

items.title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
items.summary: This research introduces 'AlphaNIST,' a system that demonstrates emergent assembly skills in robotic manipulation using binary task rewards, addressing the challenging NIST Assembly Task Board #1 benchmark.

items.title: PanTact: Teaching Whole-Body Dexterity with a Wearable Contact Interface
items.summary: PanTact is a system designed to teach humanoid robots whole-body dexterity by utilizing a wearable contact interface, extending manipulation capabilities beyond just the hands.

items.title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
items.summary: CASTER is a method for formalizing zero-shot manipulation for robots from synthetic videos, using video generation models to create task demonstrations and frame the learning as constrained optimization.

items.title: Graph-Based Heuristics for Minimum Constraint Removal in Cluttered Robot Motion Planning
items.summary: This research explores graph-based heuristics for Minimum Constraint Removal (MCR) in cluttered robot motion planning, enabling humanoid and service robots to navigate environments where obstacles might need to be temporarily moved.

items.title: Image-Based Path-Planning for Navigation of Soft-Growing Robots in the Spinal Sub-Arachnoid Space
items.summary: This research investigates image-based path-planning algorithms for soft-growing robots, enabling their navigation within the spinal sub-arachnoid space for targeted minimally invasive medical procedures.

items.title: Selectively Actuated Fiberbots for High-precision Minimally Invasive Surgery
items.summary: This paper presents electrothermally actuated fiberbots designed for high-precision minimally invasive surgery, addressing challenges in distal manipulation for MIS procedures.

items.title: PriMoRetarget: Humanoid Motion Transfer Through Prioritized Motion Retargeting
items.summary: PriMoRetarget proposes a method for transferring human motion data to humanoid robots, focusing on prioritizing motion retargeting for complex interactions with multiple characters and objects.

items.title: Non-Prehensile Multi-Object Placement with Mobile Robots via Diffusion-Based Trajectory Planning
items.summary: This research explores non-prehensile multi-object placement with mobile robots, using diffusion-based trajectory planning to achieve precision placement beyond coarse goal regions.

items.title: FallGown: A Soft Pneumatic Wearable Device for Fall Prevention
items.summary: FallGown is a soft pneumatic wearable device designed for fall prevention in older adults, functioning as an active support similar to exoskeletons or robotic assistance.

items.title: StereoEngine: Scaling Stereo Bimanual Robot Data without Stereo Cameras
items.summary: StereoEngine proposes a method to scale stereo bimanual robot data for robotic manipulation, generating large-scale stereo datasets without requiring stereo cameras.

items.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
items.summary: Reflex introduces a system for visually grounded reactive control of humanoids, enabling them to anticipate and respond reflexively with their whole body to moving targets in real-time.

items.title: Multimodal Image-based Robotic Assistance and Guidance Environment (MIRAGE): A Novel Unified Framework for Surgical Navigation and Visualization
items.summary: MIRAGE presents a novel unified framework for multimodal image-guided robotic surgery, integrating stereovision scene reconstruction and augmented reality for real-time navigation and visualization.

items.title: Tactile Sensing-based Secure and Gentle Grasping of Unknown Objects
items.summary: This paper proposes a tactile sensing-based approach for secure and gentle grasping of unknown objects in robotic manipulation, ensuring both firm grip and object integrity.

items.title: VLMs are Native Action Models: Unleashing the Manipulation Capabilities of VLMs with Explicit Action-Space Grounding
items.summary: This work explores leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as native action models for robotic manipulation by explicitly grounding them in the action space.

items.title: Evidence-Guided Counterfactual Learning for Long-Tailed Robotic Policies
items.summary: This research presents evidence-guided counterfactual learning to address long-tailed task distributions in robotic policies, improving performance on less common tasks in robot demonstration datasets.

items.title: TAME-Nav: Temporal Asymmetric Mixture-of-Experts Distillation for Agile and Versatile Robot Navigation
items.summary: TAME-Nav introduces a Temporal Asymmetric Mixture-of-Experts Distillation method for agile and versatile robot navigation, enabling embodied robots to adapt to diverse and complex scenarios.

items.title: LeapBot-JAC: Joint Action Chains for World Action Models
items.summary: LeapBot-JAC proposes Joint Action Chains for World Action Models, a method for organizing action-chunking policies to support execution and efficient replanning for robot control.

items.title: Adaptive Whole-Body MPC with Optimal Posture Planning for Humanoid Robots under Unknown Payloads
items.summary: This paper proposes an adaptive whole-body control architecture for humanoid robots to maintain balance and stability during lifting and material-handling tasks, even with unknown and varying payloads.

items.title: VICAR: Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting for Humanoid Interactive Skills
items.summary: This research presents VICAR, a system for humanoid loco-manipulation that uses third-person human videos to extract noisy motion, object trajectories, and contacts for imitation learning.

items.title: Belief-Overlap Partial Inversion: Object-Centric Flow Replanning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: This work introduces an object-centric framework for humanoids to learn how unfamiliar objects move through exploratory pushes, using the response to guide subsequent motion, specifically for pushing carts with unknown properties.

items.title: Human2Dex: Dexterous Robot Learning from Wrist-Centric Human Demonstrations
items.summary: This research investigates using a shared corpus of natural human demonstrations as a reusable data interface for different dexterous robot hands, aiming to reduce the need for task-specific data acquisition.

items.title: PATACON: GPU-Parallel Tangent-Bundle RRT-Connect for Constrained Motion Planning
items.summary: This research introduces PATACON, a GPU-parallel algorithm for fast whole-body motion planning for humanoid robots, enabling continuous replanning in dynamic environments while satisfying collision avoidance and kinematic constraints.

items.title: Evo-RL: Iterative Robot Reinforcement Learning from Selective Experience
items.summary: This research presents Evo-RL, an iterative reinforcement learning method for robots that improves policies by selectively using experience from human corrections and autonomous rollouts, focusing on valuable trajectories.

items.title: PartiGen: Part-Aware Representations for Language-Conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces PartiGen, a part-aware latent diffusion framework that integrates anatomical structure for language-conditioned humanoid motion generation, allowing for coordinated body parts and suitable robot execution references.

items.summary: This work explores improving generalist robotic intelligence by learning from human interactions and modeling failure dynamics, moving beyond just successful robot demonstrations through large-scale egocentric video datasets.

items.summary: This research presents ATHLETE, a method for learning reactive humanoid tennis skills using trajectory-guided motion matching to enable whole-body coordination under rapidly changing ball dynamics.

items.title: RARA: Robust Policy Fine-Tuning through Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This paper introduces RARA, a method for robust policy fine-tuning in robotic manipulation that uses retrieval-anchored representation alignment to adapt pre-trained robot policies, such as VLA models, to new tasks with few demonstrations.

items.summary: Introduces TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework enabling humanoid robots to navigate towards a goal in vision-denied environments by actively probing their surroundings.

items.summary: This paper proposes an informationally decoupled trajectory design method for sim-to-real system identification, aiming to improve transfer by more accurately estimating physical parameters through simulator tuning.

items.title: FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment
items.summary: This paper introduces FOCUS, a method for vision-based reinforcement learning in robotic manipulation that uses controlled modality switching and representation alignment to bridge the sim-to-real gap from privileged states to RGB-D observations.

items.title: Distributed Relative Localization Based on Ultra-WideBand and LiDAR for Multi-robot with Limited Communication
items.summary: This paper proposes a distributed relative localization method for multi-robot systems, leveraging Ultra-WideBand (UWB) and LiDAR data with limited communication to enable collaborative task performance in GPS-denied environments.
